faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes V250/V250d use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From the W447 launch in 2014 through to the 2025 refresh, the V250/V250d used the OM651 2.1-litre four-cylinder diesel. From the 2025 refresh onward, it switched to the OM654 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel - a completely different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes V250/V250d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my V250/V250d?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM651 or the OM654 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM651 V250/V250d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM654 V250/V250d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The OM654 is a newer engine - no specific known issues independently confirmed for this application at this stage, and we service it to the same standard as our other V-Class rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used V250/V250d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my V250/V250d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a V250/V250d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most V250/V250d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
